quesContent: What do you use computers for? List as many uses as you can.

choices.answerContent: I use computers for three main things. For study, I research and write assignments. For work, I manage data in spreadsheets and attend online meetings. For fun, I stream videos and play games.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: I use computers for professional productivity (data analysis, project management, communication), academic research (accessing e-libraries, running simulations), and personal use (streaming media, photo/video editing, and online gaming).
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: Which multimedia hardware items do you use for different tasks?

choices.answerContent: I use headphones or earbuds for music and online calls, and the laptop's built-in microphone for talking. I use the webcam to show my face, and I often connect to a large TV screen to watch movies.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: For professional audio input, I use a dedicated USB microphone and noise-canceling headphones for monitoring. For visuals, I rely on an external HD webcam for clear video quality and a large QHD monitor for precise photo and video editing.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: Who might use each multimedia device, and what would they use them for?

choices.answerContent: A student uses a headset with a mic for online classes. A photographer uses a large monitor to edit photos clearly. A gamer uses strong speakers for exciting game sounds.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: A Podcaster uses an external microphone to capture broadcast-quality audio. A Graphic Designer relies on a color-calibrated monitor for precise color editing. A Remote Manager uses HD webcams and noise-canceling headphones for clear virtual meetings.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.
